references.text: The description of the holy incense to be used in the tabernacle, for which the incense in the golden bowl was intended.
Refers to the golden bowls that were to be made for the tabernacle, the same type of vessels mentioned here.
Describes the making of the golden bowls for the tabernacle.
The first time the golden bowl with incense is mentioned in the same chapter, showing the pattern for the gifts of the tribal leaders.
Summary of all the golden bowls filled with incense given by the twelve tribal leaders.
Golden bowls full of incense in heaven, representing the prayers of the saints, a parallel to the incense offering.
Incense mixed with the prayers of the saints on the golden altar, showing the spiritual meaning of the incense offering.
